## Summary
Briefly describe the changes and link the related issue (e.g., `Closes #123`).

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature / SSP adapter / filter set
- [ ] Documentation improvement
- [ ] Performance / benchmark / validation update
- [ ] Refactoring / maintenance

## Scientific & Engineering Checklist
- [ ] Unit/integration tests added or updated under `tests/`
- [ ] `pytest -v` passes locally
- [ ] Numerical accuracy validated against float64 reference (where applicable)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs/` and docstrings) updated to reflect public API or CLI changes
- [ ] Code adheres to the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
